executive_summary: Binding parent direction draft preserved; all numerical and technical clarifications fixed before labels. No favorable redesign.
source_variable: same original release NCY policy median minus CY policy median; release-calendar target years, no January retargeting
availability: release date EOD America/New_York; forecast cutoff previous weekday16:00NY
target: sign(truth - original V51 median); exactzeros excluded only from fitting, retained scoring
origin_grid: All recovered original monthly V51 caches source-active and fixed-price-features available; calendar fixed before labels; inherited cache gaps disclosed, no regenerated draws
purge: actual AND weekday planned target maturity strictly before firstfold cutoff date; training2016<=year<test year; exclude testreleaseIDs, targets zero excluded from fit only
unfit_fold: Stop if no two classes; no alternate model, record operational blocker

controls.timing_fit: Identical fixed pooled logistic separately fit to each lagged pre-outcome source mapping on same purged folds, missing mapping trainexcluded/testzero shift; primary ledger never reduced
controls.persistence: Sign of previous available original policy spread; newestrelease active gate applies; previousstate may intentionally be stale

controls.price_logistic: Same fixed logistic on parent14price columns plus asset/logH, same target/folds/sharedgrid; bounded current-vintage H15 probe PIT C
controls.random: Primary directions permuted, identical application prevalence, seed31802
controls.state_null: 2000 historical-only donor feature replacements perrelease, donor index<=recipient index; fit same purged chronological folds
controls.date_null: 2000 permuted nonnegative0/5/21/42/63BD release activation delays; never symmetric or future injection; fit same purged folds

bootstrap.inference: Primary release dependence, secondary sourceweek and5year evidence; no IID cell claim

scoring: Exact imported qfbench2-common v2.4.3 fair CRPS normalized by each original past scale; ratio of sums on exact sameledger

success_gate.contemporary_beats: both5BD/21BD, price logistic and persistence strictly by>1e-12
success_gate.negative_controls: primary lower than each null5th percentile
success_gate.dominance: largest single release/year fraction of gross positive gain<0.50; chosen before labels

other_verdicts: NO if primary>=1 or timing/price/persistence fails; INCONCLUSIVE if small benefit beats controls but evidence insufficient; BLOCKED_SOURCE_DATA if GateA fails
next_axis_tree: Exactly frozen prompt four-way tree; never execute next study
conflicts: No substantive conflict; unspecified operational/control choices documented here before label access
